obs.name: tof
obs.about: the newest 3 frames first; each 8x8 zones, row 0 the top, column 0 the sensor's left; distance / 4.0 m, misses = 1

obs.name: goal
obs.about: distance / 4.0 m (max 1), sin and cos of the bearing from the robot's heading (left positive)

obs.name: lastAction
obs.about: the brain's previous raw output, clipped to [-1, 1] (not the twist)

obs.name: twist
obs.about: the smoothed command the walker follows: forward m/s, turn rad/s (alpha 0.14 per 50 Hz step)

obs.name: yawRate
obs.about: the gyro's z, rad/s, as the walking policy sees it

output.name: twist
output.about: target forward m/s (-0.1 to 0.25) and turn rad/s (+-1.0); smooth it like the stick

note: nav.onnx's lastAction input wants the raw clipped action; recover it from the twist output: forward >= 0 ? forward / VX_FORWARD : forward / VX_BACK, turn / WZ_MAX.
